name: Quest
desc: A small top-down adventure: a village, a meadow of slimes, a locked grove. The Game view's 2D world, a hero whose fields the panel is bound to, rules for picking things up, and the rest in a page of code.
vars:
Hero = {Name: "Aria", HP: 20, MaxHP: 20, Atk: 1, Gold: 0, XP: 0, Level: 1, Potions: 1, Key: 0}
Quest = {Step: 0, Slimes: 0, Need: 5}
Talk = ""
HpPct <- Round(Hero.HP * 100 / Hero.MaxHP)
HpLine <- "HP " Hero.HP " / " Hero.MaxHP
LevelLine <- "Level " Hero.Level "  ·  XP " Hero.XP " of " Hero.Level * 5
GoldLine <- Hero.Gold " gold  ·  attack " Hero.Atk
PotionLine <- "Drink a potion (" Hero.Potions ")"
QuestLine <- QuestOf(Quest)

windows.name: Main
windows.title: Quest
windows.css: #heroCard { height: 440px; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; margin-bottom: 0; }
windows.flows:
world Hit:coin -> add Hero.Gold 1
world Hit:coin -> do Pickup(eng, b, "+1 gold", "#ffd84a")
world Hit:potion -> add Hero.Potions 1
world Hit:potion -> do Pickup(eng, b, "+1 potion", "#ff8a95")
world Hit:slime -> do Hurt(eng, b)
world Hit:chest -> do OpenChest(eng)
world Key:space -> do Attack(eng)
world Key:e -> do TalkNear(eng)
world Key:q -> do DrinkPotion()
potionBtn Click -> do DrinkPotion()
potionBtn Click -> do world.Focus()
nameBox Change -> do world.Component.Set("hero", {Label: Hero.Name})
debugSw Change -> do world.Component.Debug({Stats: debugSw.Value, Colliders: debugSw.Value})
debugSw Change -> do world.Focus()
windows.binds:
nameBox <-> Hero.Name
hpText.Text <- HpLine
hpBar <- HpPct
lvText.Text <- LevelLine
goldText.Text <- GoldLine
potionBtn.Text <- PotionLine
questText.Text <- QuestLine
talkText.Text <- Talk
windows.script:
; Quest: a small top-down adventure on the Game view, in its 2D world.
;
; Where each part lives:
;   Logic > Values    Hero and Quest are values with fields. The panel on the
;                     right is bound to them, and HpLine, LevelLine, QuestLine
;                     are worked out from them, so nothing here writes to the
;                     panel: change Hero.HP, call AxBindSync(), and it follows.
;   Logic > Rules     picking up coins and potions (add to Hero, then take the
;                     thing away), and what Space, E and Q do
;   world, Tick       what happens as time goes by (Events tab of the game view)
;   this code         the map, who says what, fighting, the gate and the chest

; the running state that is nobody's business but this code's
class Play {
    static Over := false, HurtUntil := 0, TalkUntil := 0, RespawnAt := 0, NextId := 0
    static SlimeHp := Map()
}

SetupWorld() {
    eng := world.Component
    Play.SlimeHp := Map(), Play.Over := false
    eng.Clear()
    eng.World({Mode: "2d", Tile: 36, Back: "#10141c"})
    eng.Map(QuestMap(), Map(
        ".", {Color: "#4f8f3f", Deco: "grass"},
        ",", {Color: "#4f8f3f", Deco: "flowers"},
        "T", {Color: "#4f8f3f", Deco: "tree", Solid: true},
        "o", {Color: "#4f8f3f", Deco: "rock", Solid: true},
        ":", {Color: "#c8a86b", Deco: "path"},
        "~", {Color: "#2f6fb0", Deco: "water", Solid: true},
        "b", {Color: "#9b7447", Deco: "planks"},
        "R", {Color: "#b5473a", Deco: "roof", Solid: true},
        "#", {Color: "#8c8a94", Deco: "brick", Solid: true},
        "D", {Color: "#8c8a94", Deco: "door", Solid: true},
        "G", {Color: "#6b4a2f", Deco: "door", Accent: "#4a3222", Solid: true}))
    eng.Spawn("hero", {Sprite: "hero", X: 8.5, Y: 11.5, Size: 0.9, Solid: true, Control: {Speed: 5},
                       Hits: ["coin", "potion", "slime", "chest"], Label: Hero.Name, Watch: true})
    eng.Camera({Follow: "hero"})
    eng.Spawn("elder", {Sprite: "elder", X: 6.5, Y: 8.6, Size: 0.9, Solid: true, Tag: "npc", Label: "Elder Bram"})
    eng.Spawn("mira", {Sprite: "villager", X: 12.5, Y: 9.5, Size: 0.85, Solid: true, Tag: "npc", Label: "Mira",
                       Wander: {Speed: 0.6, Every: 2.5}})
    for p in [[24, 5], [30, 14], [26, 19], [36, 22], [23, 11], [33, 12]]
        AddSlime(p[1] + 0.5, p[2] + 0.5)
    for p in [[3, 11], [15, 7], [22, 3], [27, 8], [36, 16], [24, 22], [31, 22], [14, 20], [37, 11], [9, 22]]
        AddCoin(p[1] + 0.5, p[2] + 0.5)
    eng.Spawn("potion1", {Sprite: "potion", X: 16.5, Y: 21.5, Size: 0.6, Tag: "potion", Layer: 0})
    eng.Spawn("potion2", {Sprite: "potion", X: 34.5, Y: 17.5, Size: 0.6, Tag: "potion", Layer: 0})
    eng.Spawn("chest", {Sprite: "chest", X: 33.5, Y: 4.5, Size: 0.9, Tag: "chest", Radius: 0.6})
    eng.Hud("help", {Text: "WASD / arrows walk     Space swing     E talk     Q potion", X: 14, Y: -30,
                     Size: 13, Bold: false, Color: "#dfe8ff"})
    eng.Debug({Stats: false})
    world.Focus()
    Say("Aria wakes in the village. The elder looks worried: walk up to him and press E.")
}

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- things
AddSlime(x, y) {
    id := "slime" (++Play.NextId)
    Play.SlimeHp[id] := 3
    world.Component.Spawn(id, {Sprite: "slime", X: x, Y: y, Size: 0.75, Solid: true, Tag: "slime", Watch: true,
                               Wander: {Speed: 1, Every: 1.8}, Chase: {Target: "hero", Speed: 1.7, Range: 3.5}})
}
AddCoin(x, y) {
    world.Component.Spawn("coin" (++Play.NextId), {Sprite: "coin", X: x, Y: y, Size: 0.5, Tag: "coin", Layer: 0,
                                                   Bob: {Amp: 0.08, Speed: 4}})
}
; a coin or a potion picked up: the rule has already added it to Hero
Pickup(eng, id, text, colour) {
    e := eng.Entity(id)
    if !IsObject(e)
        return
    eng.Burst({X: e.X, Y: e.Y, N: 12, Color: colour, Speed: 3})
    eng.Float(e.X, e.Y - 0.5, text, {Color: colour})
    eng.Kill(id)
}

; ------------------------------------------------------------- fighting
; Space: the nearest slime within reach loses Hero.Atk, and is knocked back
Attack(eng) {
    if Play.Over
        return
    h := eng.Entity("hero")
    fx := h.Get("fx", 0), fy := h.Get("fy", 1)
    eng.Burst({X: h.X + fx * 0.6, Y: h.Y + fy * 0.6, N: 8, Color: "#ffffff", Speed: 3, Life: 0.3})
    target := eng.Near("hero", "slime", 1.7)
    if (target = "")
        return
    s := eng.Entity(target)
    Play.SlimeHp[target] := Play.SlimeHp.Get(target, 1) - Hero.Atk
    eng.Float(s.X, s.Y - 0.6, "-" Hero.Atk, {Color: "#ffe066"})
    dx := s.X - h.X, dy := s.Y - h.Y, d := Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1
    eng.Set(target, {VX: dx / d * 5, VY: dy / d * 5})
    if (Play.SlimeHp[target] > 0)
        return
    Play.SlimeHp.Delete(target)
    eng.Burst({X: s.X, Y: s.Y, N: 20, Color: "#4fbf5a", Speed: 4})
    eng.Kill(target)
    Hero.XP += 2
    if (Quest.Step = 1)
        Quest.Slimes := Min(Quest.Need, Quest.Slimes + 1)
    if (Random(1, 3) = 1)
        AddCoin(s.X, s.Y)
    if (Hero.XP >= Hero.Level * 5)
        LevelUp(eng)
    AxBindSync()
}
LevelUp(eng) {
    Hero.XP -= Hero.Level * 5
    Hero.Level += 1, Hero.MaxHP += 4, Hero.HP := Hero.MaxHP, Hero.Atk += 1
    h := eng.Entity("hero")
    eng.Float(h.X, h.Y - 1, "Level " Hero.Level "!", {Color: "#ffe066", Size: 0.7, Life: 1.6})
    eng.Burst({X: h.X, Y: h.Y, N: 24, Color: "#ffe066", Speed: 4})
}
; a slime touched the hero
Hurt(eng, slime) {
    t := IsObject(eng.LastTick) ? eng.LastTick.Time : 0
    if (Play.Over || t < Play.HurtUntil)
        return
    Play.HurtUntil := t + 1.2
    Hero.HP := Max(0, Hero.HP - 2)
    h := eng.Entity("hero"), s := eng.Entity(slime)
    if IsObject(s) {
        dx := h.X - s.X, dy := h.Y - s.Y, d := Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1
        eng.Set("hero", {VX: dx / d * 9, VY: dy / d * 9})
    }
    eng.Set("hero", {Flash: true})
    eng.Float(h.X, h.Y - 0.8, "-2", {Color: "#ff6b6b"})
    eng.Shake(0.4)
    AxBindSync()
    if (Hero.HP <= 0)
        Faint(eng)
}
Faint(eng) {
    Play.Over := true
    eng.Set("hero", {Frozen: true, Flash: false})
    eng.Hud("big", {Text: "You fainted...`nPress Enter to wake up in the village", X: "50%", Y: "35%",
                    Size: 24, Align: "center", Color: "#ffffff", Box: true})
}
DrinkPotion() {
    if Play.Over
        return
    if (Hero.Potions <= 0)
        return Say("No potions left. Mira sells them in the village.")
    if (Hero.HP >= Hero.MaxHP)
        return Say("Aria is already at full health.")
    Hero.Potions -= 1
    Hero.HP := Min(Hero.MaxHP, Hero.HP + 10)
    eng := world.Component
    h := eng.Entity("hero")
    eng.Float(h.X, h.Y - 0.8, "+10", {Color: "#7dff9a"})
    AxBindSync()
}

; --------------------------------------------------------------- talking
; E: whoever is next to the hero, or the gate
TalkNear(eng) {
    if Play.Over
        return
    who := eng.Near("hero", "npc", 1.8)
    if (who = "elder")
        return Say(ElderSays())
    if (who = "mira")
        return Say(MiraSays())
    h := eng.Entity("hero")
    loop 3 {
        dy := A_Index - 2
        loop 3 {
            dx := A_Index - 2
            if (eng.TileAt(h.X + dx, h.Y + dy) = "G")
                return OpenGate(eng)
        }
    }
}
ElderSays() {
    switch Quest.Step {
    case 0:
        Quest.Step := 1
        AxBindSync()
        return "Elder Bram: Slimes are eating the turnips! Clear five of them out of the meadow, east over the bridge. Space swings your sword."
    case 1:
        left := Quest.Need - Quest.Slimes
        if (left > 0)
            return "Elder Bram: " left " more to go. If they hurt you, Q drinks a potion."
        Quest.Step := 2, Hero.Key := 1
        AxBindSync()
        return "Elder Bram: You did it! Take this old key. It opens the grove gate in the north-east. Something shines in there."
    case 2, 3:
        return "Elder Bram: The grove is in the far north-east corner, behind the stone wall."
    default:
        return "Elder Bram: The Sunstone, back in the village! Thank you, " Hero.Name "."
    }
}
MiraSays() {
    if (Hero.Gold >= 5) {
        Hero.Gold -= 5, Hero.Potions += 1
        AxBindSync()
        return "Mira: A potion for five gold. There you go, and mind those slimes."
    }
    return "Mira: My potions are five gold each. Coins turn up all over the meadow."
}
OpenGate(eng) {
    if !Hero.Key
        return Say("The gate is locked. Someone in the village must have the key.")
    for x in [33, 34]
        eng.Tile(x, 8, ":")
    eng.Burst({X: 34, Y: 8.5, N: 16, Color: "#c8a86b", Speed: 3})
    Hero.Key := 0
    Quest.Step := Max(Quest.Step, 3)
    AxBindSync()
    Say("The key turns, and the gate creaks open.")
}
OpenChest(eng) {
    if (Quest.Step != 3)
        return
    Quest.Step := 4
    c := eng.Entity("chest")
    eng.Burst({X: c.X, Y: c.Y, N: 40, Color: "#ffd84a", Speed: 5, Life: 1.4})
    eng.Spawn("sunstone", {Sprite: "gem", X: c.X, Y: c.Y - 0.9, Size: 0.7, Layer: 2, Bob: {Amp: 0.15, Speed: 3}})
    eng.Hud("big", {Text: "You found the Sunstone!", X: "50%", Y: "35%", Size: 30, Align: "center", Color: "#ffe066"})
    SetTimer(() => eng.Hud("big"), -3500)
    Hero.Gold += 20
    AxBindSync()
    Say("A Sunstone, warm as a summer afternoon. Take it back to Elder Bram.")
}
; a line in the talk box over the world, and in Talk (bound to the panel)
Say(text) {
    global Talk
    Talk := text
    eng := world.Component
    eng.Hud("talk", {Text: Wrap(text, 62), X: "50%", Y: -124, Size: 15, Bold: false, Align: "center", Box: true})
    Play.TalkUntil := (IsObject(eng.LastTick) ? eng.LastTick.Time : 0) + 6
    AxBindSync()
}
Wrap(text, width) {
    out := "", line := ""
    for w in StrSplit(text, " ") {
        if (line != "" && StrLen(line) + 1 + StrLen(w) > width)
            out .= line "`n", line := w
        else
            line .= (line = "" ? "" : " ") w
    }
    return out line
}

; what the quest panel says: QuestLine (Logic > Values) is worked out from this
QuestOf(q) {
    switch q.Step {
    case 0: return "Talk to Elder Bram, in the village."
    case 1: return "Clear the slimes out of the east meadow: " q.Slimes " of " q.Need "."
    case 2: return "Open the grove gate in the north-east with the elder's key."
    case 3: return "Find what shines in the grove."
    default: return "Take the Sunstone back to Elder Bram. You have won!"
    }
}

; the map: one character a tile (the legend is in SetupWorld)
QuestMap() {
    return [
        "TTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTT",
        "T.................~~~..,.....##########T",
        "T....,........,,...~~~....,,.#,,,,,,,,#T",

        "T...,..::...::...~~~....o....#,,,,,,,,#T",
        "T......::...::...~~~.........####GG####T",
        "T.o...,::...::.o..~~~......::::::::.,..T",
        "T......::...::....~~~...,..::::::::.T,.T",
        "T......::..,::....~~~......::........,.T",
        "T.:::::::::::::::bbbbb:::::::.,........T",
        "T.:::::::::::::::bbbbb:::::::,......o..T",
        "T....::::::...T....~~~...........,.,,..T",
        "T....::::::.......~~~,.............T..,T",
